varve_followup.finding: First-save download-only path cleared dirty and advanced lastSavedAt after an anchor click. The browser cannot confirm whether the user retained the download.
varve_followup.resolution: Keep first and repeated download-only saves dirty; do not advance the persistent-save timestamp. Native, library, and File System Access writes retain their existing completion semantics.
varve_followup.regression: Provider-level test reproduced dirty=false before the fix; it now asserts first and subsequent download-only saves remain dirty with no lastSavedAt.
varve_followup.source_followup: PdfCraft #2601 merged 2026-10-18 fixes only the cross-origin host bridge and explicitly leaves download completion as a product decision.
